Task ID: EN20-009-ROOT
Task Name: Stage A temperature permission

Allowed operating temperatures are strictly greater than 5°C and at most 40°C: (5,40]. Operation at exactly 5°C is prohibited.

The present exercise analyzes this text only and performs no business action.
